data.title: Student points only show the last number
story: 🔥 PRODUCTION INCIDENT: A student who earned 10, 20, and 30 points is recorded with only 30 points.
Add print(total) inside the loop to see what happens, then fix it.

explanation: The line total = 0 sits inside the for loop, so total goes back to zero on every round and only the last score survives. Move total = 0 above the loop, before it starts.
hints: Print total on every round. Does the number keep growing?
Which line sends total back to 0? How many times should that line run?
Move total = 0 outside the for loop, at the same indentation as the for.
